description:
Wire github_pr_checker.py into approval_workflow for GitHub PR verdict gating. Integration glue per section 1 core loop.

MUST: Use write_service :8772 for all state exchange.
MUST: Query mcp_server_registry for MCPs with pending approval_workflow status.
MUST: Write PR check results to appropriate status columns via write_service.
MUST: Include verdict_composite score from trust_synthesiser in PR status payload.
MUST NOT: Query GitHub API directly; use github_pr_checker.py as the sole GitHub interface.
MUST NOT: Introduce HTTP between peer daemons; all via write_service.
Phase 9 integration per ZO-SENTINEL Product Specification section 1.
